model.name: five-stage Erlang immature delay plus circulating mature compartment
model.equations: I1'=p A(t)-k I1; Ij'=k(I[j-1]-Ij), j=2..5; M'=k I5-mu M; k=5/T. Densities are per mL, rates per day, and all states start at zero on day 0.
model.driver_interpolation: piecewise-linear interpolation of supplied asexual densities (fixed input)
model.solver: SciPy solve_ivp DOP853 adaptive solver; rtol=1e-08, atol=1e-10
model.observation_model: independent lognormal measurements with fitted log-SD; ND is left-censored at 2 gametocytes/mL via its lognormal CDF

diagnostics.alternative_model: One exponential immature compartment (same 4 fitted parameters) had AIC 198.62, versus 134.00 for the five-stage Erlang model (Delta AIC 64.62); its training log10 RMSE was 0.721.
diagnostics.identifiability: In this single infection, production, maturation and clearance trade off. The half-life interval uses local observed information and conditions on five stages and the fixed driver; maturation-stage count is structural, not estimated. No direct treatment effect on immature or mature states was included.
